Beef Stroganoff

Strips of seared beef in a mustard and soured cream sauce with mushrooms, done in twenty-five minutes. It is a fast dish pretending to be a slow one, and it only fails if you boil the cream.

★★★★★★★★★★4.8(3,011)Rated 4.8 out of 5 from 3011 reviews 40 min total Serves 4 servings Easy Russian
Jump to Recipe Jump to Method

Why This Recipe Works

Soured cream splits above about 80°C because its acidified proteins coagulate, so it goes in off the heat at the very end. Searing the beef in batches and removing it means the meat never simmers in liquid — it stays pink and tender while the sauce is built from its fond.

Method

Tap a step to highlight it, or turn on Cook Mode for large type and step-by-step focus.

  1. Pat the beef strips completely dry and season with half the salt and the pepper.

  2. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wide pan until smoking. Sear the beef in three batches, 60 to 90 seconds each, until browned outside and still rare within. Set aside on a plate.

  3. Add the butter and the remaining oil, then the mushrooms. Cook over high heat for 6 to 8 minutes without stirring much, until deeply browned.

  4. Add the onions and cook 6 minutes until soft, then the garlic for 1 minute.

  5. Stir in the flour and paprika and cook 2 minutes.

  6. Pour in the brandy and scrape the base clean, then add the stock and mustard. Simmer for 8 minutes until thickened.

  7. Take the pan off the heat and let it stop bubbling for a minute.

  8. Stir in the soured cream a spoonful at a time, then return the beef and any resting juices. Warm through over the lowest heat for 2 minutes without letting it simmer.

  9. Season, scatter with parsley, and serve over buttered egg noodles.

Chef’s Tips

  • Room-temperature soured cream is far less likely to split than cold from the fridge.
  • The beef finishes cooking in the residual heat of the sauce. Sear it rare.
  • Full-fat soured cream only; low-fat versions split almost immediately.

Pairing Suggestions

  • A Pinot Noir or a cold vodka
  • Serve over buttered egg noodles with a pickled cucumber
  • Finish with something light

Storage & Reheating

Refrigerate 3 days. Reheat very gently below a simmer. Freezing is not recommended — the sauce separates.
